marta: ok pushed a 1-pager draft to drive — working title 'Inference Deploy Cheatcode' (single sheet). Main hooks: security controls, SLA decision tree, deploy-mode tradeoffs, and inbound routing play. link: https://drive.redwood/example-cheatcode :eyes:
leo: sweet. can we make the benchmark line-item very visible? sales wants a 3-bullet comparison (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with latency & cost delta

leo: webinar tie-in: 45-min: 20m benchmark story, 15m demo of deploy modes, 10m Q&A. we should mention the cheatcode as a downloadable asset during signup and again in the follow-up email

jane: field asks for 1-sentence objection responses: e.g., "How do you handle data sovereignty? -> Private deployment with KMS + audit logs; we help with onboarding." 1-liner only
marta: love it. i'll edit the one-pager to include: 1) 3-bullet perf table 2) 1-line security bullets (KMS, audit logs, VPC) 3) routing box 4) webinar CTA

jane: once final, i'll map registrant flows and create SFDC campaign. also prepping a short rebuttal sheet for AE use (3 objections + scripts)
